I have implemented the `encryption` package and integrated it into the configuration, filename generation, and handler streaming pipeline on a new branch (`feature/encryption`):

- **Streaming Encryption & Decryption ([encryption/encryption.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-0ru7rruw/encryption/encryption.go))**:
  - Added [`NewEncryptor`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-0ru7rruw/encryption/encryption.go#L35-L44) validating 32-byte keys and wrapping [`ErrInvalidKey`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-0ru7rruw/encryption/encryption.go#L29).
  - Implemented [`Encryptor.EncryptWriter`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-0ru7rruw/encryption/encryption.go#L46-L65) for AES-256-GCM streaming in chunks up to 64KB with the 3-byte header (`0x4F 0x44 0x01`), 4-byte big-endian chunk length prefix, random 12-byte nonces per chunk, 4-byte zero sentinel, and 32-byte HMAC-SHA256 trailer over all bytes between header and sentinel, with idempotent `Close()`.
  - Implemented [`DecryptReader`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-0ru7rruw/encryption/encryption.go#L186-L210) with lazy initialization on `Read` and validation for header magic (`"invalid header"`), version (`"unsupported version"`), HMAC/AEAD authentication (`"integrity"`), wrong keys, and truncated streams.
- **Encryption Configuration & Key Loading ([encryption/config.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-0ru7rruw/encryption/config.go))**:
  - Defined [`Config`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-0ru7rruw/encryption/config.go#L22-L30) with [`Config.Validate`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-0ru7rruw/encryption/config.go#L32-L86) enforcing case-insensitive key sources (`env`, `file`, `literal`, `derive`) and mutually exclusive fields.
  - Added [`LoadKey`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-0ru7rruw/encryption/config.go#L88-L140) supporting `env`, `file`, `literal`, and PBKDF2-SHA256 `derive` key loading.
- **Job Config, Filename Suffixes & Handler Pipeline**:
  - Updated [`config.Job`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-0ru7rruw/config/job.go#L50-L71) with `Encryption encryption.Config`, [`Job.Encrypted`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-0ru7rruw/config/job.go#L136-L138), and exported [`Job.Validate`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-0ru7rruw/config/job.go#L113-L130).
  - Updated [`fileutil.EnsureFileSuffix`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-0ru7rruw/fileutil/filenutil.go#L30-L46) and [`fileutil.EnsureFileName`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-0ru7rruw/fileutil/filenutil.go#L48-L51) to accept `shouldEncrypt bool` before `unique` and append `.enc` idempotently after `.gz`.
  - Updated [`storageReadWriteCloser`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-0ru7rruw/handler/jobhandler.go#L31-L65) and [`JobHandler.save`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-0ru7rruw/handler/jobhandler.go#L68-L156) to fail-fast on encryption key validation/loading before storage operations and pipe gzip output through the encryptor.
